To: Ali From: Omar Subject: Something interesting I learned in Unit 4 Hi Ali, How are you? I am writing to tell you about something interesting I learned in this unit about art and expression. I discovered that art is not just painting pictures, but a powerful way to express our feelings and ideas. Artists use different materials like paper, metal, and fabric to create amazing work. I also learned about famous Egyptian stars like Omar Sharif and Amina Rizk, who showed great creativity in cinema. Art helps us see the world in new ways! Write back soon, Omar
